tools.name: boosthis_get_removal_kit
tools.description: Removing Boosthis from this project: the ordered sequence, every kit file, the package entries, the config, the calls to strip, and the Boosthis entries in an AI tool's config. Order is load-bearing - forget(), where a kit has one, only reaches the server while the key is set.

tools.name: boosthis_match_rules_for_code

tools.name: boosthis_budgets

tools.name: boosthis_what_should_i_look_at_next

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: boosthis_crash_risk, boosthis_verify_kit_install, boosthis_maintenance_mix · Private data: boosthis_get_integration_kit, boosthis_get_removal_kit, boosthis_match_rules_for_code, boosthis_session_summary, boosthis_budgets, boosthis_what_should_i_look_at_next, boosthis_snapshot, boosthis_crash_risk, boosthis_full_stack_trace, boosthis_connection_status, boosthis_which_kits, boosthis_verify_kit_install, boosthis_maintenance_mix, boosthis_trend, boosthis_vigilance, boosthis_alerts, boosthis_remember_promise, boosthis_record_change · Public sink: boosthis_get_integration_kit, boosthis_snapshot, boosthis_verify_kit_install · Destructive: boosthis_jobs, boosthis_platform_allowances.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: boosthis_crash_risk, boosthis_verify_kit_install, boosthis_maintenance_mix · Private data: boosthis_get_integration_kit, boosthis_get_removal_kit, boosthis_match_rules_for_code, boosthis_session_summary, boosthis_budgets, boosthis_what_should_i_look_at_next, boosthis_snapshot, boosthis_crash_risk, boosthis_full_stack_trace, boosthis_connection_status, boosthis_which_kits, boosthis_verify_kit_install, boosthis_maintenance_mix, boosthis_trend, boosthis_vigilance, boosthis_alerts, boosthis_remember_promise, boosthis_record_change · Public sink: boosthis_get_integration_kit, boosthis_snapshot, boosthis_verify_kit_install · Destructive: boosthis_jobs, boosthis_platform_allowances

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
